entry: # Basis rows cite arm64 srv-fleet run receipts only (witness_row_cost_basis_host_class_note).
# The clock column names WHICH clock eval_ms_basis was read from, so a comparison against an
# observation on a different clock refuses (BasisClockMismatch) instead of answering. Every row
# below carries wall because every one was seeded from a receipt that recorded no other clock:
# before the 2026-08-05 clock-basis ruling the seed's PerformanceReceipt held only wall_nanos,
# so wall is what these figures ARE, not a default chosen for them.
# First fleet observation establishes a row here; absence at compare time is BasisAbsent.
# whose sole failure was the silent-pick row's wall-budget refusal; every row below completed.
# resolution_divergence_silent_pick_gate_keystone_holds is DELIBERATELY ABSENT: it was killed at
# its 900000ms deadline, so its recorded 900794ms is a CENSORED measurement, not a completed one.
# Seeding it would pin the corpus's most expensive row WithinBasis below ~1.8M ms under the 2x
# comparator and enshrine a deadline ceiling as normal cost. It stays BasisAbsent - the honest
# third state - until ClaimOutcome::TimedOut distinguishes killed rows from completed ones.
# Rows observed in two batches keep the max of the two (all 3 such pairs differ by <2%).
